title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2201 E. Maple Street in North Canton, Ohio, as the Lance Cpl. Stacy Annie Dryden Post Office.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 2201 E. Maple Street in North Canton, Ohio, as the "Lance Cpl. Stacy 'Annie' Dryden Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a North Canton, Ohio post office after Lance Cpl. Stacy Annie Dryden.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2201 E. Maple Street in North Canton, Ohio, as the Lance Cpl. Stacy "Annie" Dryden Post Office. It is a naming measure only and does not change postal services, mail rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2020, and the new name applies from that date.
